description: Resolve one pending Replo agent interaction with the user's explicit answer. For a permission request, pass type permission and the decision from its response options. For a question, pass type question and one answers array per form step, in order, holding the selected option values, or the user's own text only where that step's allowCustom is true; an empty array skips a step. Never infer an answer. Approving or answering resumes the agent, which can then overwrite or delete content, publish, or write to an external service. Returns the updated session status; an interaction that is no longer pending returns an error and nothing is delivered, so call get_agent_session again.

answers.description: For a question: one array per form step, in order.

decision.description: For a permission: the user's selected option value from its response contract.

interactionId.description: The id copied from get_agent_session.pendingInteractions after the user answers using that interaction's response contract.

name: resolve_agent_interaction
title: Resolve Replo interaction
